reason: Instagram already fills my Friday and Saturday nights, so I don't see why I'd pay for another place to post flyers. The free listing I might try if they load the flyers for me, but I wouldn't pay anything now.
objection: You're a startup, will you still be around in six months? And 500 people on a waitlist isn't customers walking into my bar.
would_change_my_mind: Seeing the app past 2,000 active users in my city with real numbers, and a couple of nearby venues telling me it filled their slow weekday nights.
